_comment: Max Payne 3 level sections to export as GoldSrc maps into the cs16-client gamedir. Geometry comes from each level's collision mesh (.wbd/.wbn) via mp3-rpf-tools 'cs16-export'. The decoded geometry is Rockstar IP and is NOT committed -- run scripts/import_mp3_map.py against your own Max Payne 3 install. Only this manifest and the script are tracked; the work cache (.mp3cache/) and the installed .bsp/.wad (in the gamedir) are not.
_fields: name (map/bsp name), archive (level .rpf path relative to the Max Payne 3 install root), entry (.wbd/.wbn name inside it). Optional: scale (units/metre, default 40), thickness, crop ('xmin,ymin,zmin,xmax,ymax,zmax' in MP3 metres -- carve one room), max_tris, tex_scale, spawns. Textures are real level textures assigned by face orientation: tex_floor / tex_wall / tex_ceiling are .wtd texture names from the level (auto-picked by keyword if omitted); 'texture' (a PNG path) overrides all three with one image.
